title: Hotels
body:
Official Hotel Room Blocks

We've negotiated discount rates with two hotels adjacent and close to the Georgia World Congress Center. Please move quickly to reserve a room before they sell out!

  • Hyatt Regency SOLD OUT
  • Westin Peachtree Plaza SOLD OUT
  • Omni Hotel at CNN Center SOLD OUT

Other Budget-Friendly Recommendations

In addition to the official room blocks, we've identified several budget-friendly hotels with average rates of $160 USD or less. We will NOT secure room blocks with these hotels, but they may be great options for your stay in Atlanta and they are located within walking distance to Georgia World Congress Center.

  • The Glenn Hotel, Autograph Collection
  • Residence Inn Atlanta Downtown
  • The Ellis Hotel
  • Hampton Inn
  • Quality Hotel Downtown
